sources.title: Antarctic blue whale Z-call, Weddell Sea 69°S, January 2013
sources.note: One complete Z-call from a regular singer who called about every 69 s, logged at 115 dB re 1 µPa by AWI's automated Z-call detector (PANGAEA 960121). The call spans 16 s before to 10 s after its logged time and is trimmed to where 17.5–29 Hz rises 6 dB above the 10-minute recording's background (our choice). AWI Ocean Acoustics Group recording, PANGAEA 973160; 5.3 kHz recorder resampled to 2 kHz.

location.label: Weddell Sea, 69°S on the Greenwich meridian
location.note: HAFOS mooring AWI232-11 position from the PANGAEA dataset coverage (rounded).

sources.title: Antarctic blue whale Z-call, Southern Ocean 59°S, May 2013

AWI Ocean Acoustics Group recording, PANGAEA 966612; 5.3 kHz recorder resampled to 2 kHz.

location.label: Southern Ocean, 59°S on the Greenwich meridian
